defaults.a: Yes. This Nisulka Tools utility is designed to be available directly in your browser.

defaults.q: Do I need to install anything?
defaults.a: No. Use the tool directly from a modern web browser.

defaults.q: Does Nisulka Tools store my files?
defaults.a: File handling depends on the individual tool. Check the tool page before uploading sensitive information.

image-compressor.q: How do I compress an image?
image-compressor.a: Upload your image, adjust the compression options if available, then download the optimized file.
Support depends on the tool implementation; common formats include JPG, PNG and WebP.

text-to-handwriting.a: Yes. The tool provides controls for handwriting appearance, ink, paper, spacing and alignment.

text-to-handwriting.q: Can I download the handwritten result?
text-to-handwriting.a: Yes. Generate your handwriting image and use the download option provided by the tool.

youtube-thumbnail-downloader.q: How do I download a YouTube thumbnail?
youtube-thumbnail-downloader.a: Paste the YouTube video URL into the tool and choose the available thumbnail image.
